## Maintaining this file

On any new deposit to Zenodo or the Internet Archive:

    python3 tools/publication_index.py --add <key> --title "..." \
        --domain "..." --zenodo <conceptrecid> --ia <identifier> --git <path>
    python3 tools/publication_index.py --build
    git add publication/trisduction_ledger.json PUBLICATION_INDEX.md && git commit

`--verify` reconciles every address against live Zenodo, live Internet Archive, and `git ls-files`, and reports four drift classes: an address the ledger claims that is not live, a live address the ledger does not carry, a git PDF with no ledger entry, and a version DOI superseded upstream. Skipping the ledger edit does not corrupt anything; `--verify` names the omission on the next run.
